prompt.title: Prompt
paragraphs: You are a business performance analyst.
Review the provided weekly performance data and prepare a concise management update.
Keep the final management summary concise and actionable.
checklist: Identify the three most important findings.
Compare current performance with the previous period.
Prepare downloadable executive summary and supporting data.

events.content: Weekly performance improved overall, led by revenue growth and a higher conversion rate.
Key findings: revenue increased 7.3%, orders increased from 1,765 to 1,842, and conversion improved from 4.5% to 4.8%.
